column1: # HSK grammar list — imported source, HSK 1-9.
# Columns: level <TAB> title <TAB> meaning <TAB> function <TAB> register
# PROVENANCE: this list was generated by a chat model and pasted in. It is not
# a published syllabus and it is not hand-verified. It imports as
# `imported-unreviewed` and flows into the curation queue; nothing here is
# presented as checked until a human approves it.
# WHAT WAS DROPPED, and why — the source listed ~875 rows, of which these are
# not grammar and were excluded rather than imported:
#     with 发现" is a dictionary entry, not a pattern.
#   - HSK6 "Nouns" (~29 rows): vocabulary (原因, 结果, 方法, 情况).
#   - HSK7-9 "Classical nouns" (~23 rows): 仁 / 义 / 礼 / 智 / 信 / 天 / 道 are
#   - HSK7-9 formal verb vocabulary (~30 rows): 实施 / 贯彻 / 促进 / 加强.
#   - "Comparison" sections (~40 rows): these are contrast notes between two
#     points ("Comparing 才 and 就"), not patterns in their own right.
# ROWS CORRECTED against the source, which had errors:
#   - 必然 was given the pinyin "buran" and conflated with 不然 (otherwise).
#   - 提供 was listed as "provided that" (a conjunction). It means "to supply";
#     dropped, as the intended conjunction is ambiguous.
#   - 搞不懂 was glossed "as it turns out"; it means "cannot figure out".
#     Dropped as not a grammar point.
#   - 压根儿 was glossed "utterly"; it is negative-polarity only ("not at all").
#   - 精确 ("jingjiu") is jīngquè and means "precise"; not an adverb of
#   - Pinyin typos in the source (xinagxin, yiwizhe, jinpian, diding) affected
#     rows that were dropped as vocabulary anyway.
